asr.full_text: Namaste, I am Lathika Nimbalkar welcome back to my channel today I m going to show how to make matki Kaaluan for that, I am using wet matki tie the matki tightly let me show you the shape of mud let me show you from outside and this is not cotton I got so many comments that if you put it in taro cloth, it gets sticky Then see, it doesnt get sticky as much as normal They are soft and how nice they look I would like to see how deep they came And this is gauti matkhi Before putting any matkhi in to wash it 2-3 times for clean washing the water on pot to prevent it from getting dirty After 2-3 times of washing , fill it with plenty of water Fill it to 80%. Put the Matki in it now. I'm going to put it in at night. Do the same process overnight and when the next day the matki is ready we will close it. We will close it within a couple of hours only. After that we will wait for 10 hrs or more If you eat Matki before this it will give good results to your body So, I'll show you guys how to make Kalwana in using the traditional method Take one big Wadag Take the Matki out In this Gavvav method i will show you making Kaluwan I have a Wadga We will strain this mixture If you liked this recipe Then like and comment The mixture which is left over over cloth Nice turn See these we have strained Once the tempering is done, the mango will look very thin and long Once we remove the mangoes from the pan, you will see they are really thin There is a very little stickiness to them too Then we can not get a good smell as well Now, add 2 tsp Oil in a preheated tawa If oil is non-glucose it will not be well steamed and sticky. Heat the pan and add oil. After 2 spoons of oil. Add oil upto your taste and let it heat up well. Oil is heated up and add cumin and mustard seeds to it. 1 small spoon will do. Once the mustard seeds are spluttered, add curry leaves to keep the curry a bit crispy And I have taken a big cut onion Let me sauté the onions Sauté the onion like this I will reduce the flame to medium I have added 2 pinches of Hing powder Also I have added just half required. And I have also added half tbsp of turmeric powder. But I will give you some powdered ginger too. Now I will add 3 big chopped dry coconut and 3 big chopped garlic. So, now there is one big chopped-lion. It's half an inch long. And some dry coconut. All purpose and fresh coconut Now we will stir the curry Now this is done Now we will add 1 finely chopped coconut Now we will add some small piece of salt Now we will keep it or we will have no problem. Now in this, we'll now add some salt. This will help the prawn to get soft. Look after the prawn is being soft we have already stirred it well. Next, in this we're going to add the powder of 4-5 spoons of jaggery. So the coriander will enhance taste. I will add 4 to 5 tbsp powder. Powder makes the dish more tasty. If you have a metal plate, then roast the ground peanuts in it. Then add the powder in it. I have added the powder in it. Add 2 tbsp red chilli powder & mix well. Now, add 1 tbsp of garam masala powder. If you prefer kolhapuri or whatever masala you like, you can just add the spices as you like Mix all well And mix them well. Now check if the masala mixture is well fried. Now just stir it well for about a minute. Because the food smell is likely, if you use the recipe in my method. Now all we need to do is, stir the masala well. So mix these well using the mixture. Add in water according to the water quantity that you want. I am adding in 1 glass and still adding water in the same way. because it is necessary to make vegetable for 4-5 people in total. We have added 1 glass of water before also we will add the Bhaji from the pot 1 Glass Water 2 Glass Water 2 Glass water Still, the quantity of water is a little hard Still, in order to cook Matki We need to add some water Then cook Matki properly Added water in two Glass Added water in half 4-5 of People use all of this Add a half glass water This is more than sufficient for 4 to 5 people Make sure you take enough water Add salt to taste Cook it Keep heat on low Just now salt has turned brown Add a glass of water Keep it on low flame, take a look how nice they are. Now we have left the gravy with some water. Add 1 cup of coriander leaves to our rice mix like 4-5 people's bowl. I will add a little bit more because this dish has 2 cups of coriander leaves. Cook the curry again. Cook it for another 1-2 minutes on low flame for 5-7 minute If you like you can also serve this Matkicha on pava Let's check how it's look on high flame Now Matkicha is cooked This is the first time we will add coriander leaves Have it with Matkicha Also if you like this Matkicha then like, share and subscribe Subscribe my channel to watch upcoming videos
